newsitem.title: USA: General Surgical SAPHtrak balloon approved.
newsitem.headline: General Surgical SAPHtrak balloon approved.

text.p: General Surgical Innovations Inc said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration cleared it to market its Spacemaker SAPHtrak balloon dissection system in the minimally invasive removal of the saphenous vein.

It said the balloon is designed to avoid a long incision over the saphenous vein, a procedure that typically involves an incision that can span the entire length of the leg from ankle to groin, and is associated with a high incidence of infection and wound breakdown.
